sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日简报《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以观看其中一些未经修饰、直言不讳的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: The actual casting of ballots has ended, but the election is not over.
sentences.zh: 实际的投票已经结束，但选举尚未尘埃落定。

sentences.en: We never stop counting until all eligible votes are counted and added to the final certified and audited results.
sentences.zh: 在所有符合条件的选票被清点并计入最终经过认证和审计的结果之前，我们绝不会停止计票。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: I urge everybody to remain patient.
sentences.zh: 我敦促大家保持耐心。

sentences.en: At this point, I ask for patience.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，我请求大家保持耐心。

sentences.en: Please give some patience to our election officials.
sentences.zh: 请对我们的选举官员多一点耐心。

sentences.en: So many Americans exhausted by this pandemic, exhausted by these polarized times, and now Americans across this country are being asked for their patience as every vote is counted.
sentences.zh: 太多的美国人对这场疫情感到疲惫，对这个两极分化的时代感到疲惫，而现在，全国各地的美国人都被要求在每一张选票被清点时保持耐心。

sentences.en: And we knew in this pandemic, it could take time.
sentences.zh: 我们知道在这场疫情中，这可能需要时间。

sentences.en: As votes continue to be counted.
sentences.zh: 随着计票工作的持续进行。

sentences.en: 116,000 and change, absentee ballots that are still outstanding.
sentences.zh: 还有11.6万多张缺席选票尚未清点。

sentences.en: There's still a million ballots that have yet to be counted.
sentences.zh: 还有一百万张选票尚未清点。

sentences.en: What was left was early vote.
sentences.zh: 剩下的就是提前投票了。

sentences.en: How did early vote skew?
sentences.zh: 提前投票的倾向如何？

sentences.en: Very heavily Democratic.
sentences.zh: 非常倾向于民主党。

sentences.en: Joe Biden's lead in the Electoral College expands.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登在选举人团中的领先优势扩大了。

sentences.en: Biden campaign tonight, very hopeful that if they can hold on to the states where they're currently leading right now, they believe that's their path to the White House.
sentences.zh: 拜登竞选团队今晚非常乐观，他们认为如果能守住目前领先的州，这就是他们通往白宫的道路。

sentences.en: The president's biggest battlegrounds, the courtrooms in the states that will decide the presidential race.
sentences.zh: 总统最大的战场是那些将决定总统大选结果的州的法庭。

sentences.en: And President Trump files a series of lawsuits to try to block his path.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统提起了一系列诉讼，试图阻挠他的胜选之路。

sentences.en: The president vowed to go to the Supreme Court to dispute the election count.
sentences.zh: 总统誓言要诉诸最高法院，对选举计票结果提出质疑。

sentences.en: If it comes to that, we turn once again to Alex Burns for the latest on an unfinished election.
sentences.zh: 如果走到那一步，我们再次连线亚历克斯·伯恩斯，了解这场未完成选举的最新情况。

sentences.en: We are still in the thick of a very heated conteSt.
sentences.zh: 我们仍处于一场非常激烈的竞争之中。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, November 5th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月5日，星期四。

sentences.en: Alex, it felt for a moment tonight that America, all of us, potentially were going to have a full-fledged call of a projected winner of this election, and then nothing.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，今晚有一刻感觉美国，我们所有人，可能就要迎来这场选举获胜者的全面宣布了，然后却什么都没有发生。

sentences.en: Well, it certainly seemed like if some of the outstanding votes in the most closely divided states were to break for Joe Biden all at once, we would be in a position to say, yeah,
sentences.zh: 嗯，看起来确实是这样，如果那些竞争最激烈的州中尚未清点的选票能一下子转向乔·拜登，我们就能说，是的，

sentences.en: this guy's going to be the next president.
sentences.zh: 这家伙将成为下一任总统。

sentences.en: That didn't quite happen.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有完全发生。

sentences.en: Doesn't mean it's not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着它不会发生。

sentences.en: Just didn't happen all at once in as uniform a way as it would have taken for us to actually call this thing in the states that are still outstanding.
sentences.zh: 只是没有像我们预期的那样，在那些尚未出结果的州以统一的方式一下子发生。

sentences.en: And it's very possible that we will hit that point in the wee hours of the morning or sometime on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 而且很有可能我们会在凌晨或周四的某个时候达到那个节点。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: These things tend to happen in the magical hours of midnight to 6 a.m., or as we call them on the daily, the nightmare hours.
sentences.zh: 这些事情往往发生在午夜到凌晨6点的神奇时刻，或者正如我们在《每日新闻》中所称的，噩梦时刻。

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实如此。

sentences.en: So let's talk through what happened today on Wednesday, because a lot has happened, Alex, since we last talked to you not that many hours ago.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们谈谈周三发生了什么，因为亚历克斯，距离我们上次通话才过去没几个小时，就已经发生了这么多事。

sentences.en: And when we woke up on Wednesday, Biden was ahead in the electoral college, not by all that much.
sentences.zh: 周三醒来时，拜登在选举人团中领先，但优势并不大。

sentences.en: And there were six battleground states that had yet to be called, and it still felt legitimately up in the air.
sentences.zh: 还有六个摇摆州尚未宣布结果，局势依然扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: And with the caveat that it is 10 p.m.
sentences.zh: 需要提醒的是，现在是晚上10点，

sentences.en: and things could change, let's talk about those states.
sentences.zh: 情况可能会发生变化，让我们谈谈这些州。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So you're talking about three states in the north, Wisconsin, Michigan, Pennsylvania,
sentences.zh: 你指的是北部的三个州：威斯康星州、密歇根州、宾夕法尼亚州，

sentences.en: Georgia in the southeast, and then out west, Nevada and Arizona.
sentences.zh: 东南部的佐治亚州，以及西部的内华达州和亚利桑那州。

sentences.en: The last time we spoke, none of those states had been called.
sentences.zh: 我们上次通话时，这些州都没有宣布结果。

sentences.en: Just there were too many outstanding votes, particularly in the northern swing states, too many mail-in votes that had not yet been tabulated.
sentences.zh: 只是因为有太多的选票尚未清点，特别是在北部的摇摆州，有太多的邮寄选票还没有被统计。

sentences.en: And so we ended election night with a significant degree of uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 所以选举之夜结束时，我们处于一种高度不确定的状态。

sentences.en: Wednesday became much more definitive and, in most cases, more favorable for Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 周三的情况变得更加明确，在大多数情况下，对乔·拜登也更有利。

sentences.en: Well, let's start with the states where we ended up getting a firm call on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们从周三最终得出明确结果的州开始说起。

sentences.en: Let's begin with Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 先从威斯康星州说起。

sentences.en: So late into the night, early in the morning, Wisconsin looked like a very, very narrow lead
sentences.zh: 深夜到凌晨时分，威斯康星州看起来特朗普总统的领先优势非常非常微弱，

sentences.en: for President Trump, but with a ton of mail ballots not yet counted, particularly in the city and county of Milwaukee, which is very heavily Democratic, and a couple other parts
sentences.zh: 但有大量邮寄选票尚未清点，特别是在密尔沃基市和县，那里非常倾向于民主党，还有该州的其他几个地区，

sentences.en: of the state that tend to lean a little bit to the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 这些地区往往稍微偏向民主党。

sentences.en: So we were looking at Wisconsin and saying, you know, the president's ahead by a little bit there, but is that going to stand up for him when the rest of the vote comes in?
sentences.zh: 所以我们当时看着威斯康星州说，你知道，总统在那里领先一点点，但当其余选票进来时，他还能保持住吗？

sentences.en: And the answer is that it didn't, that Biden went from being down by a couple percentage points to up by just over 20,000 votes out of more than 3 million cast in the state.
sentences.zh: 答案是没能保持住，拜登从落后几个百分点，变成了在全州超过300万张选票中领先2万多票。

sentences.en: So that is a very narrow victory margin.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常微弱的胜出优势。

sentences.en: But Joe Biden will take it, right?
sentences.zh: 但乔·拜登会接受这个结果，对吧？

sentences.en: And that state was called for him.
sentences.zh: 那个州宣布由他获胜。

sentences.en: That was the first major call of Wednesday for Biden and a real sign that those blue wall
sentences.zh: 那是周三拜登拿下的第一个重要州，也是一个真正的信号，表明那些总统在2016年从民主党阵营翻转到共和党阵营的“蓝墙”

sentences.en: states that the president flipped from the Democratic column to the Republican column back in 2016 were not all going to break his way this time.
sentences.zh: 州，这次并不会全部倒向他。

sentences.en: And how does that result, 20,000 or so vote lead for Biden in Wisconsin?
sentences.zh: 那么这个结果，拜登在威斯康星州领先2万票左右，

sentences.en: How does that compare to what happened in Wisconsin in 2016?
sentences.zh: 与2016年威斯康星州的情况相比如何？

sentences.en: We've been monitoring states like Wisconsin in the Midwest so closely.
sentences.zh: 我们一直密切关注像威斯康星州这样的中西部州。

sentences.en: It's really quite similar to what happened in 2016, except the razor thin margin is tipped in the other
sentences.zh: 这确实与2016年发生的情况非常相似，只是微弱的优势向另一个

sentences.en: direction that the president won Wisconsin by, you know, not a very different margin.
sentences.zh: 方向倾斜了，总统当年赢得威斯康星州的优势，你知道，差距并不大。

sentences.en: But this time you had higher turnout in Milwaukee.
sentences.zh: 但这次密尔沃基的投票率更高。

sentences.en: You had better support for Joe Biden in the suburbs around Milwaukee.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登在密尔沃基周边郊区的支持率更高。

sentences.en: He held down some of his losses in more conservative parts of the state, even just by a little.
sentences.zh: 他在该州更保守的地区控制住了一些损失，哪怕只是一点点。

sentences.en: And then Dane County, which is Madison, very liberal area in Wisconsin, just blew it out in terms of turnout margins for Biden.
sentences.zh: 还有戴恩县，也就是麦迪逊，威斯康星州非常自由派的地区，在拜登的投票率优势方面表现得非常出色。

sentences.en: So the president did quite well in terms of turning out his base in the state.
sentences.zh: 所以总统在动员该州基本盘方面做得相当不错。

sentences.en: And he got more votes in Wisconsin this time by a good gap than he got in 2016.
sentences.zh: 而且他这次在威斯康星州获得的选票比2016年多了不少。

sentences.en: But Joe Biden improved more over what the Democrats were able to do last time.
sentences.zh: 但乔·拜登比民主党上次的表现有了更大的提升。

sentences.en: And so how does the Trump campaign respond to this call that Biden had won Wisconsin?
sentences.zh: 那么特朗普竞选团队对拜登赢得威斯康星州这一结果有何回应？

sentences.en: Well, in a matter of hours, they announced that they are going to seek a recount in the state.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在几个小时内，他们宣布将寻求在该州进行重新计票。

sentences.en: And Wisconsin law gives a candidate the right to do that if the margin is within one percentage point.
sentences.zh: 威斯康星州法律规定，如果差距在1个百分点以内，候选人有权这样做。

sentences.en: But the catch is that unless it's even tighter than that, then the candidate who asked for the recount has to pay for it.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，除非差距比这更小，否则要求重新计票的候选人必须自费。

sentences.en: So that is what the Trump campaign says it is going to do.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是特朗普竞选团队声称要做的。

sentences.en: There is not really any precedent for a recount making up a gap of 20,000 plus ballots.
sentences.zh: 实际上，并没有重新计票能弥补2万多张选票差距的先例。

sentences.en: And in fact, you had Scott Walker, the former Republican governor of the state, say on
sentences.zh: 事实上，该州前共和党州长斯科特·沃克在

sentences.en: Wednesday, you know, effectively, I'm paraphrasing, that this is not the kind of margin that you can overcome with a recount.
sentences.zh: 周三表示，你知道，我转述一下，这种差距是无法通过重新计票来扭转的。

sentences.en: In the 2016 election, there actually was a recount in Wisconsin that the third party candidate,
sentences.zh: 在2016年的选举中，威斯康星州确实进行过一次重新计票，那是第三方候选人，

sentences.en: Jill Stein from the Green Party, sought a recount in that vote.
sentences.zh: 绿党的吉尔·斯坦寻求对那次投票进行重新计票。

sentences.en: And when all was said and done, it only changed 131 ballots, which was not nearly enough to affect the outcome of a state that the president won four years ago.
sentences.zh: 最终结果显示，只改变了131张选票，这远不足以影响总统四年前获胜的那个州的结果。

sentences.en: So the recount request aside, Wisconsin, we can now say, is in the Biden column.
sentences.zh: 所以撇开重新计票的要求不谈，我们现在可以说，威斯康星州已进入拜登的囊中。

sentences.en: And Alex, you have told us that Biden had very much needed a win from this cluster of states
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，你曾告诉我们，拜登非常需要赢得该地区的一组州，即特朗普四年前表现出色的威斯康星州、密歇根州和宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: in that region that Trump had done so well in four years ago, Wisconsin, Michigan, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, in a lot of ways, the simplest way for Biden to put together 270 electoral college votes
sentences.zh: 你知道，在很多方面，拜登获得270张选举人票最简单的方法，

sentences.en: is to win those three states that you just mentioned, to reassemble the blue wall of states
sentences.zh: 就是赢得你刚才提到的那三个州，重建那道在2016年之前的几十年里，

sentences.en: that did not vote for a Republican in any presidential election for decades prior to 2016.
sentences.zh: 在任何总统选举中都没有投票给共和党的“蓝墙”州。

sentences.en: That if Biden can just tip them back this time, that gets him where he needs to go.
sentences.zh: 如果拜登这次能把它们赢回来，就能达到他需要的目标。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Speaking of the blue wall, what happened in neighboring Michigan on Wednesday?
sentences.zh: 说到“蓝墙”，周三邻近的密歇根州发生了什么？

sentences.en: So Michigan is really the next domino to fall.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州确实是下一个倒下的多米诺骨牌。

sentences.en: And we see a pretty similar dynamic there that going into Wednesday morning, the president had a lead that was actually wider than his lead in Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 我们看到那里有非常相似的动态，周三早上之前，总统的领先优势实际上比他在威斯康星州的领先优势还要大。

sentences.en: But again, you had a ton of mail-in votes yet to be counted.
sentences.zh: 但同样，还有大量邮寄选票尚未清点。

sentences.en: And it's worth just stressing that the reason why they were not counted yet was because Republican
sentences.zh: 值得强调的是，它们之所以还没有被清点，是因为共和党

sentences.en: state legislators refused to change the law in the state to accommodate the volume of mail-in ballots that were coming in.
sentences.zh: 州议员拒绝修改该州法律，以适应即将到来的大量邮寄选票。

sentences.en: So when you enter the day, the president is up by a big margin over Biden in Michigan, but steadily over a period of hours.
sentences.zh: 所以当你进入这一天时，总统在密歇根州对拜登有很大的领先优势，但在几个小时的时间里，我们稳步地看到选票进来，并将该州翻转给了拜登，

sentences.en: We saw that vote come in and flip the state to Biden, actually more convincingly than in
sentences.zh: 实际上比在威斯康星州更具说服力，密歇根州对乔·拜登来说并非大胜，但他最终领先

sentences.en: Wisconsin, that Michigan is not a blowout for Joe Biden, but he ended up with a lead there
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统约12万票，超过两个完整的百分点，并且在该州获得了绝对多数的选票。

sentences.en: of about 120,000 votes over President Trump, more than two full percentage points and with an outright majority of the vote in the state.
sentences.zh: 所以他在那里的表现相当稳健，这再次表明，他成功地利用了

sentences.en: So that's quite a solid performance for him there and a sign that, again, he was managing to tap into
sentences.zh: 该州历史上支持民主党的选民群体，在城市中获得了他所需的投票率，并赢得了那些可能更温和的郊区选民，从而抵消了总统在农村地区的优势。

sentences.en: these historically Democratic constituencies in this state to get the turnout that he needed in the
sentences.zh: 所以我们在周三晚些时候收到了密歇根州的结果。

sentences.en: cities and to win over some of those maybe more moderate suburbs to offset the president's strength in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 但如果你把这两者结合起来，你就会开始看到副总统拜登在这些北部摇摆州中相当令人鼓舞的局面。

sentences.en: So we get a call in Michigan a little bit later in the day on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But you piece those two together and you're starting to get a pretty encouraging picture of those northern swing states for Vice President Biden.
sentences.zh: 当密歇根州在威斯康星州之后紧接着宣布结果时，一个接一个，感觉就像拜登的胜选之路正在拓宽。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的道路确实开始收窄了。

sentences.en: When Michigan is called right after Wisconsin, one after the other, it's starting to feel right, like Biden's paths to victory are broadening.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Trump's are really starting to narrow.
sentences.zh: 一旦你拿下了密歇根州，乔·拜登就真的进入了获得270张选举人票的打击范围内，

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 他不需要再有太多的州倒向他就能锁定这场选举。

sentences.en: That once you get Michigan, that's when Joe Biden is really within a striking distance of
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是你开始看到总统真正升级他的言论，以毫无根据的理由攻击投票合法性的时候。

sentences.en: 270 electoral college votes, where he doesn't need a whole lot more to break his way in order to lock up this election.
